$comment: Pinned server files. Every file has a fixed URL and SHA-256; scripts/server.mjs refuses anything that does not match. Upstream checksums: Java from Adoptium, server.jar SHA-1 from Mojang's version manifest, Carpet SHA-512 from Modrinth. The Fabric launcher is generated by meta.fabricmc.net and has no published checksum; its hash was recorded at first download (trust on first use). On first start the launcher downloads Fabric Loader libraries from maven.fabricmc.net over HTTPS.
